Name: True Hair Color
Author: RunaBlizzard
Description:
This mod is a pretty basic retexture of hair shading, and the only thing it really does is making white the default color, but it still keeps the shading (which is also made lighter). This gives you all the freedom with the color you want without the awkward gray mud! Works on all hairstyles, but won't work on any modded ones. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Here's a couple examples of what you can (but not limited to) do:

I thank this community for inspiring me!
